author_answer.example_en: Good personal hygiene is part of my daily routine.
author_answer.example_zh: 保持良好的个人卫生是我日常生活的一部分。
author_answer.usage_note: personal hygiene包含清洁身体、口腔及衣物等习惯，不只是洗澡。

author_answer.example_en: I clean the bathroom sink every Saturday.
author_answer.example_zh: 我每周六都清洁浴室洗手池。
author_answer.usage_note: clean作动词表示清洁；在这里不是形容词“干净的”。

author_answer.example_en: Rinse the soap off your hands with clean water.
author_answer.example_zh: 用清水把手上的肥皂冲掉。
author_answer.usage_note: rinse侧重用水冲去泡沫或残留物；wash更泛指清洗。

author_answer.example_en: I scrub the sink with a soft brush.
author_answer.example_zh: 我用软刷用力刷洗洗手池。
author_answer.usage_note: scrub比wipe更强调来回用力摩擦。

author_answer.example_en: Wipe the mirror with a clean cloth.
author_answer.example_zh: 用一块干净的布擦镜子。
author_answer.usage_note: wipe可表示擦拭水迹或污渍，不必使用清洁剂。

author_answer.example_en: Dry your hands with a clean towel.
author_answer.example_zh: 用干净的毛巾把手擦干。
author_answer.usage_note: dry既可作形容词也可作动词；此处为“擦干”。

author_answer.example_en: I'll freshen up before our guests arrive.
author_answer.example_zh: 客人到之前我要简单梳洗一下。
author_answer.usage_note: freshen up常指快速整理仪容，不一定完成整套洗澡流程。

author_answer.example_en: I want to get clean after working in the garden.
author_answer.example_zh: 在花园干活后，我想洗干净身上的泥土。
author_answer.usage_note: get clean强调由脏到干净的结果；clean up也可用于整理环境。

author_answer.example_en: The bathroom is down the hall on the left.
author_answer.example_zh: 卫生间在走廊左边。
author_answer.usage_note: bathroom在北美可指带马桶的卫生间，不一定有浴缸。

author_answer.example_en: There's a toothbrush beside the sink.
author_answer.example_zh: 洗手池旁边放着一把牙刷。
collocations: wash your hands at the sink
author_answer.usage_note: sink是洗手池或水槽；厨房也可以有sink。

author_answer.example_en: Turn off the faucet while brushing your teeth.
author_answer.example_zh: 刷牙时把水龙头关上。
author_answer.usage_note: faucet是北美英语常用的水龙头说法，英式多说tap。

author_answer.example_en: The tap is dripping; could you tighten it?
author_answer.example_zh: 水龙头在滴水，你能拧紧一点吗？
author_answer.usage_note: tap在英式英语常指水龙头，北美常说faucet。

author_answer.example_en: Wash your hands under running water.
author_answer.example_zh: 用流动的自来水洗手。
author_answer.usage_note: running water表示流动的水，不是奔跑的水；不限定水温。

author_answer.example_en: Use warm water to wash your face.
author_answer.example_zh: 用温水洗脸。
author_answer.usage_note: warm water表示温暖、不烫的水；lukewarm更强调微温。

author_answer.example_en: I splash cold water on my face to wake up.
author_answer.example_zh: 我往脸上扑了点冷水，让自己清醒。
author_answer.usage_note: cold water是冷水；与cool water相比通常更冷。

author_answer.example_en: Be careful—the hot water is very hot.
author_answer.example_zh: 小心，热水很烫。
author_answer.usage_note: hot water表示热水，注意与warm water温水的程度区别。

author_answer.example_en: This soap is gentle on my skin.
author_answer.example_zh: 这种肥皂对我的皮肤很温和。
author_answer.usage_note: soap在物质意义上多不可数，一块肥皂常说a bar of soap。

author_answer.example_en: I prefer body wash to bar soap in the shower.
author_answer.example_zh: 淋浴时我更喜欢用沐浴露，而不是香皂。
author_answer.usage_note: body wash和shower gel常指相近产品，具体质地与命名依品牌不同。

author_answer.example_en: I keep the shower gel on the shelf in the shower.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把沐浴露放在淋浴间的架子上。
author_answer.usage_note: shower gel用于洗澡；body wash是相近的常用说法。

author_answer.example_en: Could you hand me a clean towel?
author_answer.example_zh: 你能递给我一条干净的毛巾吗？
author_answer.usage_note: towel是可数名词；bath towel通常比hand towel大。

author_answer.example_en: There's a hand towel beside the sink.
author_answer.example_zh: 洗手池旁边有条擦手巾。
author_answer.usage_note: hand towel一般比bath towel小，用于擦手。

author_answer.example_en: I hung the bath towel up to dry.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把浴巾挂起来晾干。
collocations: wrap yourself in a bath towel
author_answer.usage_note: bath towel是较大的擦身浴巾，区别于hand towel。

author_answer.example_en: I checked my hair in the mirror before leaving.
author_answer.example_zh: 出门前我照镜子看了看头发。
author_answer.usage_note: 英语习惯说look in the mirror，侧重镜中映像。

author_answer.example_en: Don't forget to pack your toiletries for the trip.
author_answer.example_zh: 旅行时别忘了带上洗漱用品。
author_answer.usage_note: toiletries通常用复数，指牙膏、洗发水等个人洗护用品。

author_answer.example_en: I keep my toothbrush and toothpaste in a toiletry bag.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把牙刷和牙膏装在洗漱包里。
author_answer.usage_note: toiletry bag也叫wash bag，指装洗护用品的小包。

author_answer.example_en: Pull the shower curtain closed before turning on the water.
author_answer.example_zh: 开水前先把浴帘拉好。
author_answer.usage_note: shower curtain是浴帘，用来挡住淋浴时溅出的水。

author_answer.example_en: The showerhead has several spray settings.
author_answer.example_zh: 这个淋浴喷头有几档出水模式。
author_answer.usage_note: showerhead是淋浴喷头，shower是淋浴装置或淋浴行为。

author_answer.example_en: Hair can collect around the shower drain.
author_answer.example_zh: 头发容易积在淋浴排水口周围。
author_answer.usage_note: drain作名词是排水口或排水管，作动词可表示排水。

author_answer.example_en: The water pressure is low in the shower this morning.
author_answer.example_zh: 今天早上淋浴水压很低。
author_answer.usage_note: water pressure指水压，low表示出水力度偏小。

author_answer.example_en: I replace my toothbrush when the bristles start to fray.
author_answer.example_zh: 牙刷毛开始散开时，我就换牙刷。
author_answer.usage_note: toothbrush是牙刷；toothbrush bristles指刷毛。

author_answer.example_en: I need to buy another tube of toothpaste.
author_answer.example_zh: 我需要再买一支牙膏。
author_answer.usage_note: toothpaste通常不可数；一支牙膏说a tube of toothpaste。

author_answer.example_en: My electric toothbrush needs charging.
author_answer.example_zh: 我的电动牙刷需要充电了。
author_answer.usage_note: electric toothbrush是电动牙刷；manual toothbrush是手动牙刷。

author_answer.example_en: The toothbrush bristles are starting to bend.
author_answer.example_zh: 牙刷的刷毛开始弯曲了。
author_answer.usage_note: bristles常用复数，指牙刷、刷子等的短硬毛。

author_answer.example_en: I keep dental floss in the bathroom cabinet.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把牙线放在浴室柜里。
author_answer.usage_note: floss作名词是牙线，也可作动词表示用牙线清洁牙齿。

author_answer.example_en: I keep dental floss next to my toothbrush.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把牙线放在牙刷旁边。
author_answer.usage_note: dental floss为牙线的正式常用名称；floss也可单独使用。

author_answer.example_en: I use a floss pick when I'm traveling.
author_answer.example_zh: 旅行时我会用牙线棒。
author_answer.usage_note: floss pick是带手柄的牙线棒，与卷装牙线dental floss区别。

author_answer.example_en: She uses mouthwash after brushing her teeth.
author_answer.example_zh: 她刷牙后会用漱口水。
author_answer.usage_note: mouthwash是漱口水，通常不可数；不是普通的饮用水。

author_answer.example_en: Brushing and flossing are part of good dental hygiene.
author_answer.example_zh: 刷牙和使用牙线是良好口腔卫生习惯的一部分。
author_answer.usage_note: dental hygiene专指牙齿及牙龈清洁，personal hygiene范围更广。

author_answer.example_en: I brushed my tongue gently while brushing my teeth.
author_answer.example_zh: 刷牙时我也轻轻刷了刷舌头。
author_answer.usage_note: tongue是舌头；发音中的gue不单独读出。

author_answer.example_en: My gums sometimes bleed when I floss.
author_answer.example_zh: 我用牙线时牙龈有时会出血。
author_answer.usage_note: gums在牙科语境表示牙龈；gum单数也可指口香糖的另一义项。

author_answer.example_en: Dental plaque can build up along the gumline.
author_answer.example_zh: 牙菌斑可能积聚在牙龈边缘。
author_answer.usage_note: plaque在此是牙菌斑，不是纪念牌的另一义项。

author_answer.example_en: I worry about bad breath after drinking coffee.
author_answer.example_zh: 喝完咖啡后我担心会有口臭。
author_answer.usage_note: bad breath是常用的口臭表达；morning breath特指睡醒后的口气。

author_answer.example_en: I replaced the blade in my razor yesterday.
author_answer.example_zh: 我昨天换了剃刀的刀片。
author_answer.usage_note: razor泛指剃刀或刮毛刀；electric shaver通常指电动剃须刀。

author_answer.example_en: I use shaving cream before shaving my face.
author_answer.example_zh: 刮胡子前我会涂剃须膏。
author_answer.usage_note: shaving cream是剃须膏或泡沫，主要用于剃须时润滑。

author_answer.example_en: This face wash doesn't make my skin feel dry.
author_answer.example_zh: 这款洗面奶不会让我觉得皮肤干燥。
author_answer.usage_note: face wash指用于洗脸的清洁产品，产品名称常作不可数名词。

author_answer.example_en: I use a gentle cleanser before applying moisturizer.
author_answer.example_zh: 涂保湿霜前，我先用温和的洁面产品清洁皮肤。
author_answer.usage_note: cleanser泛指清洁剂；facial cleanser特指面部清洁产品。

author_answer.example_en: I apply moisturizer after washing my face.
author_answer.example_zh: 洗脸后我会涂保湿霜。
author_answer.usage_note: moisturizer用于帮助皮肤保持水分；cream与lotion可以是不同质地的保湿产品。

author_answer.example_en: I prefer a light lotion in the summer.
author_answer.example_zh: 夏天我更喜欢质地轻薄的乳液。
author_answer.usage_note: lotion通常指较稀的液态护肤乳液，不一定都用于脸部。

author_answer.example_en: I ran out of shampoo this morning.
author_answer.example_zh: 今天早上我的洗发水用完了。
author_answer.usage_note: shampoo作产品名词通常不可数，也可作动词表示用洗发水洗头。

author_answer.example_en: I put conditioner on the ends of my hair.
author_answer.example_zh: 我把护发素抹在发梢上。
author_answer.usage_note: conditioner在此指护发素；leave-in conditioner指免冲洗护发产品。

author_answer.example_en: I brush my teeth after breakfast.
author_answer.example_zh: 我吃完早饭后刷牙。
collocations: brush your teeth twice a day
author_answer.usage_note: teeth是tooth的复数；通常说brush your teeth，不说wash your teeth。

author_answer.example_en: I rinsed my mouth with water after brushing.
author_answer.example_zh: 刷完牙后我用水漱了口。
author_answer.usage_note: rinse your mouth表示在口中含水后漱净，与rinse your face不同。

author_answer.example_en: I floss my teeth before going to bed.
author_answer.example_zh: 睡前我用牙线清洁牙缝。
author_answer.usage_note: floss作动词表示使用牙线，和brush your teeth动作不同。

author_answer.example_en: Please wash your hands with soap before eating.
author_answer.example_zh: 吃东西前请用肥皂洗手。
author_answer.usage_note: wash your hands表示用水洗手，常接with soap说明用品。

author_answer.example_en: Make sure you rinse off the soap completely.
author_answer.example_zh: 一定要把肥皂彻底冲干净。
author_answer.usage_note: rinse off可分开，代词置中：rinse it off。

author_answer.example_en: I wash my face with lukewarm water in the morning.
author_answer.example_zh: 我早上用温水洗脸。
author_answer.usage_note: wash your face是日常洗脸说法；lukewarm表示不烫的温水。

author_answer.example_en: Rinse thoroughly until no shampoo is left in your hair.
author_answer.example_zh: 彻底冲洗，直到头发上不再残留洗发水。
author_answer.usage_note: thoroughly强调各处都冲洗到，不只是快速过一遍水。

author_answer.example_en: Rinse your hair with warm water after shampooing.
author_answer.example_zh: 用洗发水洗完头后，用温水冲洗头发。
author_answer.usage_note: rinse强调冲净泡沫，wash your hair更侧重洗头的整个过程。

author_answer.example_en: I comb my hair before tying it back.
author_answer.example_zh: 我扎头发之前先梳一梳。
author_answer.usage_note: comb常强调使用梳子，brush your hair通常指使用发刷。

author_answer.example_en: I shave my face before going to work.
author_answer.example_zh: 上班前我会刮胡子。
author_answer.usage_note: shave your face表示剃除面部毛发；shave还可作不及物动词。

author_answer.example_en: She shaves her legs before going swimming.
author_answer.example_zh: 她去游泳前会刮腿毛。
author_answer.usage_note: shave表示剃掉体毛，不等于trim（修剪至较短）。

author_answer.example_en: If soap gets in your eyes, rinse out your eyes with clean water.
author_answer.example_zh: 如果肥皂进了眼睛，就用清水冲洗眼睛。
author_answer.usage_note: rinse out强调把进入眼部的异物或刺激物冲出去；这里是语言例句而非医疗处置方案。

author_answer.example_en: Rinse off any residue before drying your skin.
author_answer.example_zh: 擦干皮肤前，先把残留物冲掉。
author_answer.usage_note: residue指洗护用品等留下的残留物，rinse off表示用水冲去。
